knowledge:
- key_parameters: <geneIdType=specifies the type of gene identifier (e.g., "GENENAME", "ENTREZID") ;; organism=specifies the organism (e.g., "Sc" for yeast, "Hs" for human) ;; key=determines whether the network is gene-based ("Genes", default) or term-based ("Terms") ;; filterAttribute=column from the clusters or metagroups data frame used to filter the network ;; filterOperator=logical operator for filtering (e.g., "<", ">", "!=") ;; filterThreshold=threshold value for the filter attribute ;; plotType=specifies the network type (e.g., "bipartite" or default) ;; plotOutput=controls the output format ("dynamic" for interactive tkplot, "none" to return igraph object without plotting, or default static) ;; geneExpr=optional vector of gene expression values (e.g., 1 for UP, -1 for DW) to color nodes>
- alternatives: <fea_topGO()=use for offline Gene Ontology enrichment without clustering (treats each gene-term set as a cluster) ;; fea_gage()=use for gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) when raw expression data and sample groups are available ;; format_david()=use to import Functional Annotation Clustering results downloaded from the DAVID website (since direct API queries are no longer supported in R) ;; format_results() or readGeneTermSets()=use to import custom/other FEA tool outputs>
- when_to_use: <Use when you have a list of genes (or expression data) from an experiment and want to move from a gene-centric list to a functional-module centric network representation to visualize overlapping biological functions, identify key hub genes, or generate an HTML summary report.>
- pitfalls: <fea_david() is no longer supported directly in R; users must run DAVID on the website and import the downloaded text file using format_david() ;; The Graphical User Interface (FGNet_GUI()) requires RGtk2, which is deprecated/unavailable in newer R versions (since April 2022) ;; fea_gtLinker() is no longer available/supported directly for new runs, but results can be retrieved via fea_gtLinker_getResults() using a pre-existing job ID ;; Gene-Term Linker groups multiple terms into each gene-term set, so direct bipartite plotting of gene-term sets might not be appropriate without formatting.>

workflows.name: topgo_gene_list_to_network
workflows.intent: Perform GO enrichment analysis on a gene list offline and build a functional network.
input: genesYeastExpr (optional named numeric vector of gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform FEA using fea_topGO() ;; 2. Generate an HTML report using FGNet_report() ;; 3. Convert results to incidence matrices using fea2incidMat() ;; 4. Plot the network using functionalNetwork()
workflows.code:
feaResults_topGO <- fea_topGO(genesYeast, geneIdType="GENENAME", organism="Sc")
FGNet_report(feaResults_topGO, geneExpr=genesYeastExpr)
incidMat <- fea2incidMat(feaResults_topGO)
functionalNetwork(incidMat, geneExpr=genesYeastExpr, plotTitleSub="Default gene view")

workflows.name: gage_expression_to_network
workflows.intent: Perform gene set enrichment analysis on an expression matrix and build a functional network.
input: geneLabels (named character vector mapping probe/Entrez IDs to symbols)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform GSEA using fea_gage() ;; 2. Generate an HTML report using FGNet_report() ;; 3. Convert results to incidence matrices using fea2incidMat() ;; 4. Plot the network using functionalNetwork()
workflows.code:
feaResults_gage <- fea_gage(eset=gse16873,
                         refSamples=grep('HN',colnames(gse16873)),
                         compSamples=grep('DCIS',colnames(gse16873)),
                         geneLabels=geneLabels, annotations="REACTOME",
                         geneIdType="ENTREZID", organism="Hs")
FGNet_report(feaResults_gage)
incidMat <- fea2incidMat(feaResults_gage)
functionalNetwork(incidMat, plotOutput="dynamic")

workflows.name: import_david_to_network
workflows.intent: Import Functional Annotation Clustering results from the DAVID website and build a functional network.
input: genesYeastExpr (optional named numeric vector of gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Import results using format_david() ;; 2. Generate an HTML report using FGNet_report() ;; 3. Convert results to incidence matrices using fea2incidMat() ;; 4. Plot the network using functionalNetwork()
workflows.code:
feaResults_David <- format_david("http://david.abcc.ncifcrf.gov/data/download/90128.txt")
FGNet_report(feaResults_David, geneExpr=genesYeastExpr)
incidMat <- fea2incidMat(feaResults_David)
functionalNetwork(incidMat)
